Information Technology","languages":[{"name":"Vietnamese","level":"native"},{"name":"English","level":"fluent"},{"name":"German","level":"B2"}],"strengths":["Fast-paced first- and second-level support: about 35 tickets per week in Freshservice, in English and German.","Solid Microsoft 365 and Intune practice: around 250 laptops enrolled via Autopilot and MFA rolled out to all users in 2024.","Scripting for efficiency: PowerShell scripts save the team about two hours per onboarding wave.","Covers hardware, printers and network basics, including Cisco Meraki access points in the Raunheim warehouse.","Documented team-facing work: knowledge-base articles for common issues."],"weaknesses":["For a second-level system administration role, server administration (e.g. Windows Server, Active Directory management) is not documented beyond password resets as an intern.","Networking is listed only at basics level (DHCP, DNS, VLAN basics), without configuration responsibility.","No Linux or virtualisation experience is mentioned.","The German level is B2, and the CV does not show a higher level or a German-language certificate beyond telc B2."],"tips":["Describe in one or two lines the Active Directory and Group Policy tasks you handled at the warehouses, with numbers if possible.","Name concrete network or Meraki tasks you configured yourself, not only monitored or supported.","Add a line on any Linux or virtualisation exposure, or state clearly that you have none yet.","Keep the MD-102 and ITIL 4 entries with their dates and consider adding a sentence on what each covered in practice.","Mention the Intune and Autopilot scope for the warehouse handhelds in a bullet with a count, as it is a strong differentiator."]}
